title: Investor Behavior and the Benefits of Dispersed Stock Ownership
sources_checked: Current local final dataset: historical artifact BCH Data Sheet.xlsx; BCH Data Sheet sheet; SHA-256 e6d2aa7e36baf875cca1b333160c4b9b1a6e6187be300727783b542e2638b209; 269 participant rows. Aggregate StartDate/EndDate coverage is 2016-12-15 through 2017-01-10.

BCH Data Description Sheet.pdf, pp. 2-3, current accepted package: Qualtrics survey export retrieved 2017-02-15; hand-coded mid-term polls received 2016-10-03, 2016-10-20, and 2016-11-23; Starbucks card data received 2017-02-10; final workbook named BCH Data Sheet.

Current job working copy work/BCH Stata Code.do (SHA-256 0c0f67ab1fddb82f5399e2d844bd5530c31170b5a9840cb5e5bd619357596326), plus original package code BCH Stata Code.do (SHA-256 29aecb67aaecb5db752bbbd143028992a7b80410566b38f87ee13b70de18d292): accepted route imports the final workbook and performs main tables 1-7; no date field is used as a model period.
Accepted predecessor output/executions/packages/jar-dbdde12f5f95/report.json and its named run receipt: original main stage completed; no extended-sample result or added-period counts exist.

Project local resource catalog output/feasibility_reproduction/resources/catalog.json: exact-name query returned no BCH Data Sheet, Qualtrics participant data, or Starbucks participant purchase-data entries; it lists no compatible later source for this cohort.
changes: Recorded the observed cohort response window from the workbook's aggregate StartDate/EndDate fields (2016-12-15 to 2017-01-10), resolving the sample record's missing overall calendar bounds without treating response dates as a panel clock.

Calculated the requested five-year endpoint as 2022-01-10. The retained participant experiment has no later cohort or repeatable observation unit to pool, so the extension is not applicable; the accepted estimator and code were not altered.
limitations: The study is a one-time, between-participants experiment. The workbook's participant survey timestamps span 2016-12-15 to 2017-01-10; purchase-date fields describe measurement windows and do not form participant-by-time observations. Source retrieval dates in the data description are not observation-time coverage.

The accepted package contains the final historical workbook and the main Stata program. Although the data description names the raw survey, paper polls, and Starbucks card records, no later cohort inputs or compatible repeated-data construction route are present in the checked package/catalog. The assigned stage is therefore not extended or re-estimated.

The sample record leaves the overall period blank and mentions 2016-17 only for one university in a later analysis. The workbook supplies an aggregate response-date window for the full final dataset; this clarifies the collection dates but does not change the fixed-cohort design.

The accepted predecessor scope excludes the exploratory online appendix and raw acquisition. The appendix describes a separate 94 university-by-treatment-group-by-week series and school/subgroup analyses; those programs and the weekly input/producer were not part of the assigned main-table stage and remain outside this job.
